# Use the confusion matrix values from supp.pdf page4 to compute accuracy
tp_refs = get_rows("supp.pdf", "page4")
# Extract values from the confusion matrix rows
tp = int(tp_refs[4][1])  # R5C2: 21 (Sensitive + PR = TP
fp = int(tp_refs[4][2])  # R5C3: 5 (Sensitive + PD = FP
fn = int(tp_refs[6][1])  # R7C2: 4 (Resistant + PR = FN
tn = int(tp_refs[6][2])  # R7C3: 24 (Resistant + PD = TN

total = tp + fp + fn + tn
accuracy = (tp + tn) / total

print(f"TP: {tp}, FP: {fp}, FN: {fn}, TN: {tn}, Total: {total}, Accuracy: {accuracy}")

# Build contract with valid reference-bound values
CONTRACT = {
    "status": "computed",
    "fields": {

        "direction": {"value": "lower_sensitive", "evidence": ["article:p128"], "explanation": "Lower viability ratio indicates higher LCO sensitivity to treatment"},
        "threshold_rule": {"value": "roc_optimized", "evidence": ["article:p35", "article:p128"], "explanation": "Cutoff was determined via ROC analysis to discriminate clinical response"},
        "threshold_timing": {"value": "outcome_optimized", "evidence": ["article:p35"], "explanation": "ROC optimization used the same 54-unit evaluation cohort"},
        "patient_mapping": {"value": "individual_available", "evidence": ["article:p35"], "explanation": "Individual LCO-DST and clinical response are linked for each unit"},
        "regimen_match": {"value": "matched", "evidence": ["article:p35"], "explanation": "Clinical regimens were identical to LCO-DST test regimens for all included units"},
        "n_units": {"value": 54, "evidence": ["article:p35", "article:p101"], "explanation": "Total of 54 LCOs included in the accuracy analysis"},

            *[{"id": f"TN_{i}", "score": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page4/R7C3", "map": {"24": 0}}, "truth": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page4/R4C2", "map": {"PD": 0}}} for i in range(tn)]
